title: Best Exercises for 80-Year-Olds Starting Out
description: Safe, seated & standing moves proven to build stamina in 4 weeks — learn how
primaryKeyword: best exercises for 80 year olds starting out
perplexityQuestions: What is the best exercise routine for seniors over 60 who are just starting from zero?
How many minutes a day should a 70-year-old exercise if they have been inactive for years?
Is it safe for a 68-year-old to start strength training with dumbbells or resistance bands?
What exercises are best for seniors with arthritis in the hands, knees, or hips?
Can seniors over 75 do HIIT, or is high-intensity interval training too risky?
competitorCoverage: Top-ranking articles for this topic usually explain the main exercise types older adults need: aerobic activity, strength training, balance work, and flexibility, plus how much activity to aim for each week.[1][9][11] They also tend to include safety basics such as starting slowly, warming up, listening to pain or breathlessness, and checking with a clinician before beginning a new routine, especially if the person has chronic conditions or takes heart/blood pressure medicine.[5][7][17][19] A new article needs to go beyond generic advice by answering very specific scenario-based questions, offering clear progression steps for beginners, and addressing medical edge cases and practical barriers like low stamina, fear of injury, and limited mobility.
